section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses goal-setting theory, differentiating between performance goals and learning goals. It reviews existing research on how goal content (performance vs. learning) and goal proximity (proximal vs. distal) influence performance, skill acquisition, and self-regulatory processes, suggesting learning goals are often more effective for complex tasks. The section concludes by presenting Hypothesis 2 and Hypothesis 3.
